scripts.functions:stage: pnpm --dir functions run build && node functions/scripts/stage-deploy.mjs
scripts.emulators:check: pnpm run functions:stage && firebase emulators:exec ${FIREBASE_CONFIG:+--config "$FIREBASE_CONFIG"} --only auth,firestore,functions,storage 'true'
scripts.emulators:test: pnpm run functions:stage && firebase emulators:exec ${FIREBASE_CONFIG:+--config "$FIREBASE_CONFIG"} --only firestore,functions,auth 'pnpm --dir functions run test:integration'
scripts.rules:test: firebase emulators:exec ${FIREBASE_CONFIG:+--config "$FIREBASE_CONFIG"} --only firestore 'pnpm --dir functions run test:rules'
